# Linear

## Addresses

- New issue: `https://linear.new` or `https://linear.app/new`
- New issue in a team: `https://linear.app/team/${teamId}/new`

## How to work

- Linear is built around the keyboard. Use the new-issue links, command search and direct issue links.
- Stay in the signed-in session, and don't guess deep URLs for existing work.
- For an existing issue or project, stay on its page and edit it there.

## Keys

| Action | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| Search everything | `/` |
| Recent issues or issue search | `O` then `I` |
| Inbox | `G` then `I` |
| Command menu | `Cmd/Ctrl+K` |
| Search this view | `Cmd/Ctrl+F` |
| Show or hide project details | `Cmd/Ctrl+I` |
| New issue / full-screen composer | `C` / `V` |
| Edit this issue | `E` |
| Project documents | `O` then `D` |
| Snooze an inbox item | `H` |
| Unsubscribe from an issue (inbox) | `Shift+S` |
